simple.meaning: טוּר (ṭûwr) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a row ; hence, a wall.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 28:17. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טוּר (H2905) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: טוּר (ṭûwr) / H2905 is traced through Exodus 28:17, Exodus 28:18, Exodus 28:19, Exodus 28:20 with generated occurrence evidence.

It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams, that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

definitions.full: H2905. tur טוּר noun masculine Exod 28:17 row — absolute ׳ט 28:17 9 t.; construct id. 28:17 3 t.; plural טוּרִים 28:17 7 t.; טֻרִים 1Kin 7:20 ; construct טוּרֵי Exod 39:10 2 t.; — 1 row, course of building-stones, in temple and in Solomon's house 1Kin 6:36 ; 7:12 ; forming enclosures in corner of court Ezek 46:23 a; of beams Ezekiel 6:36; 7:12 , see also 7:4 (Th Klo, see שְׁקֻפִים שֶׁקֶף, ); of pillars 7:2-3 ,. 2 row of jewels, on high priest's breast-piece Exod 28:17 (3 t. in verse); 28:18-19 , 20 ; 39:10 (3 t. in verse); 39:11-12 , 13 (all P); of pomegranates on capitals of pillars in temple 1Kin 7:20 , 42 ; 2Chr 4:13 , so also probably 1Kin 7:18 , see Th Klo, after ᵐ5 ; of knops round the molten sea 7:24 , compare 2Chr 4:3 (oxen הַבָּקָר , erroneous for הַמְּקָעִים 1Kin 7:24 ).
